description: Defines a public enum 'NetworkInterfaces' with a static method 'primaryIPv4Address' that retrieves the primary IPv4 address of the 'en0' network interface or falls back to another address if 'en0' is not available.

methods.name: primaryIPv4Address
methods.description: Returns the primary IPv4 address as a String?, checking 'en0' interface first, then fallback.
